findings.summary: A login 401 was treated as an expired authenticated session and redirected away from the form error.
University request failures were collapsed into an empty array, hiding the difference between a network failure and an empty API result.
Explore repeated its purpose in a large secondary headline directly under the Explore title.
The personalized Home greeting was oversized and followed by redundant movement copy.
Several Explore and action cards relied on flat color alone and read as unfinished placeholders.
The You screen ended its profile content with two generic stat cards instead of a distinctive user-specific module.
Settings toggles live only in component state and are not persisted or consumed elsewhere.
Every content screen loads behind a bare ActivityIndicator; no skeletons mirror the final layout.
findings.resolution: Skeletons mirroring PostCard/EventCard/PeopleGrid replaced the bare spinners.

findings.summary: No offline detection or banner anywhere, though every screen is now API-fed.
findings.resolution: NetworkProvider plus an OfflineBanner on Home, Events and Connect.

findings.summary: Privacy, notification and appearance toggles persist nowhere and are read by nothing, while real endpoints for all three now exist. Privacy toggles in particular promise control they do not deliver.
findings.resolution: Privacy, notification and appearance settings now persist to real endpoints and device storage.

findings.summary: ScrollView wraps unbounded API-fed lists on events groups, profile posts, saved and connect.
findings.resolution: Events groups and profile posts are FlatLists.

findings.summary: Em-dashes in three visible strings, which MOBILE-DESIGN.md bans outright.
Connect (nearby people, the product differentiator) is href:null while Create occupies a tab slot; the tab bar is the default Home/Explore/Create/Campus/You shape.
findings.resolution: Tabs are now Home/Connect/Events/Campus/You; Create moved to the Home header.

findings.summary: Profile refetches profile and stats on every tab focus with no staleness guard.
findings.resolution: Profile refetch is rate-limited to once per 30s on focus.

findings.summary: Three LinearGradient usages against a declared single-sanctioned-gradient commitment.
findings.resolution: The design doc now states the gradient rule as 'scrims over media only' and names the three.

findings.summary: Compose and account text inputs omit autoCapitalize/autoComplete.
findings.resolution: autoCapitalize/autoCorrect added; new forms carry keyboardType and textContentType.

findings.summary: MOBILE-DESIGN.md is stale: its Known Gaps still claim the feed is mock-fed and /api/social unwired, and it points at features/campus/mock.ts which is now types.ts.
findings.resolution: MOBILE-DESIGN.md rewritten against the current app.

findings.summary: Saved can never show content: adaptPost hardcodes saved:false and no bookmark endpoint exists, so the save button writes to state discarded on refresh.
findings.resolution: Saved posts persist device-locally via SavedPostsContext.

findings.summary: Screen's bottom padding is a no-op ternary (? 0 : 0), and settings-family scrollables use fixed bottom padding instead of insets.
findings.resolution: Screen's bottom inset works; SettingsShell opts in.

findings.summary: Inline hex #14100C in the tab bar shadow instead of an elevation token.
findings.resolution: Tab bar shadow uses the culture.ink token.
